limitations: Harbor token fields cover only cleanly parsed product results; this dataset recovers additional usage from Astra stdout or local pipeline feedback.
journal_observed token values are minimum observed usage and may omit the terminal failed LLM request.
CPU, RAM, GPU, disk I/O, network bytes and monetary cost were not recorded.
Task durations overlap because trials ran concurrently; summed task-seconds are not batch wall-clock time.
All included trials have trigger_hit=false, lifecycle_gate_passed=false and formal_score_eligible=false.
Astra 56 是排除 33 个必须完整重跑任务后的条件样本；Hermes 64 是进行中批次的时间截面。
主对比使用 46 个同任务交集；64 对 56 的全样本数字只用于各自快照描述。
Hermes 使用 zai/glm-5.2、max_turns=90；Astra 模型标识不透明、max_turns=50，不能把差异单独归因于 runner。
Astra rounds 与 Hermes api_call_count、Astra ToolCallFailed 与 Hermes tool.completed.error 是近似映射，不是完全相同的埋点。
Astra 的 23 个 journal token 是可观测下界；Hermes 1 个 launcher 失败没有 session/token。
两边全部 formal_score_eligible=false，结果均为探索性而非正式 C0 分数。
CPU、RAM、GPU、磁盘、网络字节和实际美元成本不可比较。
